name: ua-cross-border
description: Ukrainian cross-border tax for tax year 2026 under the Tax Code of Ukraine. Covers residence of individuals (home, centre of vital interests, 183 days, citizenship) and companies, how non-residents are taxed, the permanent establishment test (12-month sites, 183-day services, dependent agents, preparatory exclusions), withholding on Ukrainian-source income under art. 141.4 (15%, freight 6%, insurance 0/4/12%, Eurobond interest 5%, the gross-up), treaty relief with residence certificates and beneficial ownership (art. 103), foreign tax credits, controlled foreign companies under art. 39-2 (control tests, exemptions, the EUR 2 million threshold, the CFC report and 60-day notices), CFC profit of individuals (art. 170.13), leaving Ukraine (art. 179.3) and the fines. Trigger on: Ukraine withholding tax non-resident, податок на репатріацію, КІК, controlled foreign company Ukraine, residence certificate Ukraine, permanent establishment Ukraine.
